component.name: Linux EPUB Reader (Audiobook Preview)
component.summary: Preview local EPUB and M4B audiobook playback

description.p: Preview build for testing local M4B audiobook playback alongside the stable Linux EPUB Reader installation. Uses a separate application identity and reading-state directory.

A simple, text-oriented EPUB reader with continuous chapter scrolling, a contents panel, search, bookmarks, saved reading positions, EPUB cover artwork and an illustrated welcome-back panel with a Resume action.

The M4B audiobook preview includes a cover-led player, rounded transport controls, working volume and mute controls, playback speed, readable embedded chapter navigation, and background loading/status monitoring to keep the interface responsive.
The app uses Atkinson Hyperlegible with a dark reading surface. It works locally and does not need network access to read books.
This is not a browser-grade EPUB renderer. Complex publisher layouts, illustrations, embedded media, and Adobe DRM are not supported.
